Author: Infi, Sl0nderman, harbingerftw
Name: Blue Mage & Beastmaster Helper
Description:
Adds a window to show all Blue Mage Magic and Beastmaster Pets you still need to collect.
Lets you search by zone or name providing quick buttons to teleport to the mob or open the Duty Finder to the correct one. Also adds headmarkers to the mobs you still need, making it easy to see in the world which is the right one.
Punchline: Helps fill out your Blue Mage Spellbook & Beastmaster Beastiary!
